note: The suite disc psm-suite-s3: demo/psm/suite/build.py --tag s3 --list demo/psm/suite/suite_s3.json. s2 plus ao0 (AO method 2's hardware questions), ao1 (the town's AO demo), a3e-auto-t2 and a3e-poll (the town with the arch fixed: town v2). RUN ALL runs the five that have not given pages yet, ao0 first; the tests that ran on s1 are picked by hand. Times are ESTIMATE, not measured. The town ELFs are Junior's autorun builds with the suite hooks, in his build folders outside the repository.

tests.name: ao0
tests.what: AO in the shadow target: union test, cost. ~20 s
tests.read: no pad; photo both pages; START = live view (X K, Y way)

tests.name: ao1
tests.what: town v2 AO: OFF, 1 baked, 2 PVR map. ~1 min
tests.read: photo every page; AO1/AO2 against OFF, map TAv/KB

tests.name: a3e-t2
tests.what: town v2 (arch fixed) a3e, KOS waits timed. ~2 min
tests.read: photo every page; the new baseline, read against a3e-poll

tests.name: a3e-poll
tests.what: town v2, the PVR waits polled. ~2 min
tests.read: photo every page; waits and timeouts against a3e-t2

tests.name: hud1b-auto
tests.what: HUD loss test, boot steps (town v1). ~3 min
tests.read: photo the pages; if it stops, photo the BOOT list/fault

tests.name: c4g
tests.what: PVR shadow chain (ran on s1). ~1 min
tests.read: photo every text page (about 12); the 8 graphs if wanted

tests.name: r3-d
tests.read: photo all 4 pages: 2 text, the graph, the picture

tests.name: a3e-auto
tests.what: town v1 a3e, fixed script (ran on s1). ~2 min
tests.read: no pad needed; photo every page (text, 2 graphs)

tests.name: a3f-auto
tests.what: town v1 a3f, cache pads (ran on s1). ~2 min
tests.read: photo every page; it is read against a3e-auto

tests.name: bake1-auto
tests.what: town v1, the static bake (ran on s1). ~2 min
tests.read: photo every page; the bakes lines are the result

tests.name: qr-q2
tests.what: QR reading: 16 codes (ran on s1). No timing
tests.read: phone at each of 7 code pages; one photo a page; Y level
